object.description: Run the GUI's command (mellon-gui) with --version in a subprocess from a source checkout, with QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen. Expected: exit status 0 within 30 s, and no top-level window is created (in-process: the entry point returns 0 without building a Project Explorer).
